hooks.command: bash -c 'R="$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd)"; [ -n "$R" ] || exit 0; f="$R/.claude/hooks/guard-outside.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$R" node "$f"; else exit 0; fi'

node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const p=((JSON.parse(d||"{}")).tool_input||{}).file_path||"";if(/\.env($|\.)/.test(p)&&!/\.env\.example$/.test(p)){console.error("BLOCKED: 禁止直接寫入 .env 檔案，請使用 .env.example");process.exit(2)}});'

node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const c=((JSON.parse(d||"{}")).tool_input||{}).command||"";const allow=process.env.ALLOW_FORCE==="1"||/(^|\s)ALLOW_FORCE=1(\s|$)/.test(c);const force=/git\s+push\b.*--force|git\s+push\b.*\s-f\b/.test(c);const hard=/git\s+reset\s+--hard/.test(c);if((force||hard)&&allow){console.error("⚠️ ALLOW_FORCE 已啟用，本次放行危險 git 操作");process.exit(0)}if(force){console.error("BLOCKED: 禁止 force push（確認需要請前置 ALLOW_FORCE=1）");process.exit(2)}if(hard){console.error("BLOCKED: 禁止 reset --hard，可能遺失未 commit 的變更（確認需要請前置 ALLOW_FORCE=1）");process.exit(2)}});'
bash -c 'R="$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd)"; [ -n "$R" ] || exit 0; f="$R/.claude/hooks/guard-push-main.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then node "$f"; else exit 0; fi'
bash -c 'R="$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd)"; [ -n "$R" ] || exit 0; f="$R/.claude/hooks/guard-pr-draft.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then node "$f"; else exit 0; fi'
bash -c 'R="$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd)"; [ -n "$R" ] || exit 0; f="$R/.claude/hooks/mark-untrusted.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then node "$f"; else exit 0; fi'
